snippet.title: False Positive Paradox - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
False Positive Paradox is OUT! Play it here: https://whilegameisfalse.itch.io/false-positive-paradox

I teased this back in September when I finished my first draft. It then took 2 months to have playtesters play it and make all the improvements ... but it's finally out.
